title: dynamic-qa Baseline Plan v1
description: Strict, versioned contract for the customer file qa/baseline-plan.yaml (DESIGN-dynamic-qa-spec.md §5.4, SPEC-135.md user stories 42-44 and 103). Produced by qa-setup stage 8 ('Establish measurement readiness') whenever required baseline evidence is missing: setup pauses with readiness 'measurement-required' rather than inventing success evidence, and a later explicit invocation resumes purely from this file. Unknown, zero, and not-applicable are three distinct, mutually exclusive states for every numerator and denominator (never collapsed into one another), so a missing denominator can never masquerade as a good result. This document is the human-readable contract; dynamic-qa/shared/scripts/baseline-plan.mjs is the hand-written fail-closed validator, constructor, renderer, and resume reader that enforces it (no JSON Schema validator dependency is added — see dynamic-qa/DECISIONS.md and the run brief's deterministic-core decision).

schema.description: Immutable. Any other value, including a plausible future version string, is an unsupported-schema-version error, not a silent upgrade attempt.

id.description: Immutable, semantic, kebab-case Baseline Plan ID.

revision.description: Monotonically increasing integer, starting at 1, incremented each time the plan is resumed and re-evaluated.

repository.description: The repository identity this plan measures (e.g. 'org/repo').

startedAt.description: When baseline collection began. The burn-in gate (14 calendar days minimum) is measured from here.

metrics.description: Exactly the six required baselines (flow-coverage, escaped-regressions, pr-check-latency-p95, flake-rate, maintenance-time, repair-decisions), one each, no more, no fewer. A baseline that does not yet apply is still present, carrying a not-applicable Quantity with a reason, never simply absent.

query.description: The exact query or collection method. Required even before any evidence exists — this is the explicit collection method the ticket requires for every baseline.

source.description: The system queried for this metric.

collectedAt.description: Required non-null ISO 8601 timestamp when numerator or denominator carries a known value; required null otherwise — a timestamp here with no known value would misleadingly claim a real collection happened.

readiness.description: Always recomputed from the metrics/window actually present; never hand-set. 'ready' requires every metric to be either fully measured or legitimately not-applicable, AND the burn-in gate (>=14 calendar days since window.startedAt, >=20 relevant completed PR runs) to have cleared.

quantity.description: The three-state value type every numerator and denominator must be. 'unknown' means evidence not yet collected. 'not-applicable' means this metric does not apply here, with a mandatory reason. 'known' carries an actual measured number, where 0 is an entirely ordinary value distinguished from 'unknown' by tag, never by value. There is no fourth, implicit 'missing' state: a field is always one of these three.
